user.title: Dynamic Energy Tariff Compare
user.description: Compare a dynamic electricity tariff (Tibber, Rabot Energy, Octopus, …) with your fixed tariff. The price sensor must deliver the FINAL all-in price per kWh (incl. grid fees, taxes, levies, VAT and provider markup). The defaults are examples only.

data.provider_name: Provider name (optional, e.g. Tibber, Rabot Energy, Octopus)
data.energy_entity: Grid import energy sensor (e.g. EDL21 total active energy / OBIS 1.8.0)
data.price_entity: Price sensor: final all-in price per kWh

data_description.provider_name: Only used for display (device and entry name). Entity IDs stay the same.
data_description.price_entity: Pick a sensor that already includes all surcharges, e.g. your provider's integration (Tibber, …) or EPEX Spot with surcharges configured. 15-min price lists in attributes are used when present, otherwise the current state. Units: €/kWh, ct/kWh, €/MWh.
data_description.provider_monthly_fee_eur: Monthly fee of the dynamic tariff (provider base fee; add grid base fee/metering here if it differs from your fixed tariff). The default is only an example.

error.unknown_price_unit: The price sensor's unit '{unit}' is not supported (use €/kWh, ct/kWh or €/MWh) and it has no price list attributes.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This energy sensor is already configured.
